infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: LoopIn uses your location during active dates so trusted contacts can find you if you miss a check-in.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: LoopIn keeps your location history on your account so you and your trusted circle can see where you've been, even while the app is in the background.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: LoopIn lets you privately record audio during a date as personal evidence, stored only on your device.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: LoopIn lets you save a match's profile photos and screenshots privately on your device.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: LoopIn lets you snap a photo of a match's profile to keep privately on your device.
